BRAND IDENTITY / PORTFOLIO PROJECT

Foot Impact

A community identity that connects digital communication, reports and the materials people use in the field.

DESIGNER / ODUSINA ISAACDISCIPLINE / BRAND IDENTITYVIEW THE PROJECT GALLERY ↓

Context

The collection connects an organisation’s public communication with the materials used by its team.

Visual direction

A green footprint mark, a stacked wordmark and curved bands give the identity a recognisable structure.

Design decisions

The report and website presentations combine photographs with generous white space. The green mark remains prominent on apparel, notebooks and bags.

Applications

Seven design presentations cover the identity overview, website, annual report, field apparel, banner, notebook and tote bag. The website is presented as a mockup.
